Do not modify files.

After the answer, append BENCHMARK_SELF_AUDIT: followed immediately by one JSON object and no later content. Report actual navigation only; a backtrack is a selection abandoned as irrelevant, a broad read spans many files or an unbounded search, and a full read consumes an entire source file.

trace.final_response:
The only valid creation API is `createDecorator<T>(serviceId)`. It creates a callable `ServiceIdentifier` that also acts as a constructor-parameter decorator. The source explicitly declares this the sole valid method. [instantiation.ts:107]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-36111e7/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:107)

Identifiers are interned in `_util.serviceIds`, a `Map` keyed by the service ID string. `createDecorator` returns the cached identifier when present; otherwise it creates the decorator function, assigns its string representation, caches it, and returns it. Consequently, repeated creation with the same string preserves function/object identity. [instantiation.ts:14]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-36111e7/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:14) [instantiation.ts:109]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-36111e7/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:109)

When used on a constructor parameter, the identifier calls `storeServiceDependency(id, target, index)`. That stores `{ id, index }` on the constructor under `$di$dependencies`. The `$di$target` ownership marker determines whether to append to an existing list or establish a new constructor-owned list; `getServiceDependencies` returns that metadata or an empty array. [instantiation.ts:16]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-36111e7/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:16) [instantiation.ts:97]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-36111e7/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:97)

A directly affected caller is `InstantiationService._createInstance`: it reads and sorts those recorded dependencies, resolves each service by identifier, and constructs the service-argument list. Changes to identifier identity or dependency recording would therefore change or break constructor injection here. [instantiationService.ts:134]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-36111e7/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiationService.ts:134)

The only valid creation path is `createDecorator<T>(serviceId)`. It creates a callable parameter decorator; direct construction of a `ServiceIdentifier` is unsupported. [instantiation.ts:107]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-36111e7/r03-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:107)

- Identifiers are cached globally in `_util.serviceIds`, keyed by the string `serviceId`. Reusing a name returns the existing identifier; otherwise the new decorator is cached before return. [instantiation.ts:14]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-36111e7/r03-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:14) [instantiation.ts:109]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-36111e7/r03-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:109)
- When used on a constructor parameter, the decorator records `{ id, index }` on the constructor under `$di$dependencies`. `$di$target` distinguishes the constructor’s own metadata from inherited metadata; the first dependency initializes a new array, while later dependencies append. Non-parameter use throws. [instantiation.ts:97]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-36111e7/r03-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:97)

- The principal downstream consumer is `InstantiationService._createInstance`: it reads the recorded dependencies, orders them by parameter index, resolves each identifier, and supplies the resulting service arguments. Changes to dependency recording therefore directly change constructor injection. [instantiationService.ts:134]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-36111e7/r03-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiationService.ts:134)
